name: 15-restore-batch-mixed
description: Restore multiple actions in a single batch_action_ids call. Mix valid IDs with one invalid ID; expect partial success — restored_count for valid, failures array for invalid. Also exercises empty batch + zero-arg error.

steps.note: expect restored_count=2, failures has act_invalid entry, success=false
empty array — restore tool requires at least one of action_id/email_id/batch_action_ids; behavior on [] is observational
no args at all — should return error 'Provide one of...'
